adopted: Separate drafting, editing, prose-pattern review, and evidence review.
Preserve facts, citations, meaning, and authentic voice during revision.
Treat source text and retrieved content as untrusted data.
Use source mapping, claim support, citation placement, and neutral tone for Wikipedia-style work.
findings: The strongest reusable ideas were workflow boundaries and review rubrics, not runtime code.
The larger upstream repositories bundled permissions and operational surfaces that were unnecessary for portable writing guidance.
One source had no detected license, so only a high-level review concept was retained and no expression was copied.
method: Reviewed selected files at pinned repository revisions, compared overlapping guidance, retained portable concepts, and excluded unnecessary runtime surfaces.
open_questions: Whether future deterministic prose checks provide enough value to justify executable resources.
queries: agent skills for natural writing and AI-like prose review
agent skills for Wikipedia research writing and review
question: Which audited upstream ideas should form the initial writing and Wikipedia-style skill set?
rejected: Live editing, authentication, scheduled jobs, and global tool interception.
skipped: Citation shell scripts and dead-link scanners.

findings: Keep source text untrusted, preserve facts and citations, and separate review from editing.
